title: IIT Guwahati Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Junior Project Officer Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Junior Project Officer Jobs. Candidates with M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering or M.Sc can apply for the IIT Guwahati Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
